raw_response:
The figure consists of two side-by-side line charts that display BLEU scores as a function of two different hyperparameters, α and p, respectively. Both charts share the same y-axis label "BLEU" with a linear scale ranging from approximately 28.0 to 28.5, with tick intervals of 0.1.

In the left chart, the x-axis represents α with values at 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, and 0.9. The y-axis represents BLEU. A single blue line with circular markers connects the data points. The line begins at approximately 27.99 at α = 0.1, rises to about 28.33 at α = 0.3, reaches a peak of approximately 28.53 at α = 0.5, then decreases to about 28.40 at α = 0.7, and further drops to approximately 28.12 at α = 0.9.

In the right chart, the x-axis represents p with values at 0.05, 0.15, 0.25, 0.35, and 0.45. The y-axis represents BLEU. A single blue line with circular markers connects the data points. The line starts at approximately 28.31 at p = 0.05, rises to a peak of approximately 28.53 at p = 0.15, then decreases to about 28.42 at p = 0.25, increases slightly to approximately 28.47 at p = 0.35, and then decreases again to about 28.43 at p = 0.45.
